run_messenger_service: run the messenger chat service by executing the run function with parsed options
setup_messenger_args: set up and parse command line arguments for the messenger chat service using ParlaiParser
parse_messenger_config: parse a configuration file and merge world options into the messenger service options dict
start_messenger_manager: start the MessengerManager task and ensure it shuts down cleanly on any exception
review_messenger_runner: review the messenger runner module that sets up args, parses config, and runs the MessengerManager
